auth_details: Free Bearer token required. Obtain at https://api.le-systeme-solaire.net/generatekey.html (active email). Send header: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY_GUID>.
description: Solar System OpenData (Le Système solaire) is a free public REST API that serves physical and orbital data for solar system bodies: planets, moons, asteroids, comets, and dwarf planets. Data includes mass, density, gravity, escape velocity, mean radius, semi-major axis, and related properties. Access remains free but requires a free Bearer token (generatekey.html); JSON over HTTPS.
